role: Exploratory mechanism diagnostic, separate from the primary comparison. Added after the first intermediate state had been evaluated. No weight selection.
inputs: Use all 16 existing validation sources, two C/D wordings and the 0/180 scene-cue hidden vectors already produced by greedy inference.
design: Cross the two pixel views with the two saved same-source Agent hidden vectors. Verify own-view embeddings against deployment, store all four vectors. No empty or artificial hidden vector. Score original-correct minus original-reverse text for all four cells with the deployed frozen readout.
quantities: Write s_ij for raw original-oriented positive-minus-negative margin at pixels i, hidden j (0 original, 1 rotated). Natural mean signed margin=(s00-s11)/2. Pixel contribution=(s00+s01-s10-s11)/4. Hidden contribution=(s00+s10-s01-s11)/4. This describes a frozen-readout intervention for this pair of views. Also count strict both-correct with swapped priors, or with one same-source prior fixed on both pixels.
